formulas.description: The Case's default reason, which will automatically be filled if certain phrases are added to the subject or description.
formulas.name: forT_DefaultCaseReason
formulas.expression: IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "aannemer"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "aannemer") ), "Contractors", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "account"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "account"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "website"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "website"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "app"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "app") ), "Account / Website / App", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "adresgegevens"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "adresgegevens"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "betaalgegevens"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "betaalgegevens") ), "Address And Payment Details", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "geschil"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "geschil") ), "Dispute Advisory Committee", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "huurcommissie"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "huurcommissie") ), "Rent Committee", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "inzage"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "inzage") ), "Request For Inspection", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "juridisch"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "juridisch"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "procedure"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "procedure") ), "Legal Procedure", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "aftersales"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "aftersales") ), "Aftersales", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "agressie"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "agressie"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "bedreiging"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "bedreiging") ), "Aggression / Threat", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "deurwaarder"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "deurwaarder") ), "Bailiff", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "makelaar"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "makelaar") ), "Broker", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "belcomputer"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}), "belcomputer") ), "Call Computer", "" ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) )

formulas.description: The Case's default type, which will automatically be filled if certain phrases are added to the subject or description.
formulas.name: forT_DefaultCaseType
formulas.expression: IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "algemeen"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "algemene") ), "General", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "betaling") ), "Paymentt", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "onderhoud") ), "Maintenance", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "speciaal"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "speciale") ), "Specials", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "veiligheid"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "protocol") ), "Safety Protocol", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "huur"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "koop") ), "Rent and Sell", IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}), "district") ), "District Management", "" ) ) ) ) ) ) )

formulas.description: The Case's default priority, which will automatically be filled if certain phrases are added to the subject or description.
formulas.name: forT_DefaultPriority
formulas.expression: IF( OR( CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}),"urgent"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}),"spoed"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Subject}),"belang"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}),"urgent"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}),"spoed"), CONTAINS(LOWER({!Description}),"belang") ), "High", "Medium" )
